design_intent: Deliver a high-density, multi-pane developer workspace interface maintaining macro composition and visual hierarchy without code-size-induced composition simplification.

information_hierarchy.title: Workspace Header and Navigation
information_hierarchy.description: Topmost operational bar exposing repository context, status indicator, and global command trigger.

information_hierarchy.title: Dual-Pane Operational Canvas
information_hierarchy.description: Primary content region divided into collateral navigator (left) and active document viewer (right).

information_hierarchy.title: Docked Secondary Inspector
information_hierarchy.description: Bottom contextual inspector displaying diagnostics, metadata, and execution telemetry.

macro_composition.description: 3-region vertical grid with fixed header (48px), flex primary workspace (1fr), and docked bottom tray (auto/collapsible).
Prominent left-aligned breadcrumb title with right-aligned action group maintaining high-contrast primary CTA.
Horizontal split-pane on viewports >= 1024px; below 1024px navigation collapses to a drawer while content follows the breakpoint-specific full-width or single-column flow.

pattern_application_reason: Canonical CUIR-3 navigation and disclosure patterns provide evidence-bound guidance for explicit destination state and responsive collapse. The reference handoff intentionally omits project-native and provider-specific evidence unless a consuming project supplies traceable sources.

responsive_transformations.transformation: Multi-column split view with visible sidebar and expanded document canvas.
Sidebar collapsed to drawer toggle; main content occupies full viewport width.
Single-column vertical stack with drawer overlay navigation.

asset_requirements.usage: Use an accepted consuming-project icon for the global command trigger; no project-native icon identity is assumed by this Orchestra reference.
Use the consuming project's accepted base-surface design token; no token path is invented by this Orchestra reference.

preserve: Preserve desktop-macro-grid layout structure across all desktop viewports.
Preserve action-bar-visual-hierarchy with unambiguous primary action salience.
Preserve split-pane-responsive-collapse behavior without dropping navigation or inspector accessibility.
Preserve keyboard navigability (Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape, Enter) across all interactive elements.
adapt: Adapt column widths fluidly between minimum and maximum constraints.
Adapt bottom dock height according to inspector content volume.
avoid: Do not replace required multi-region composition with flat single-pane layout to reduce code size.
Do not remove split-pane divider to avoid implementing drag/collapse interactions.
Do not invent unrequested modal dialogs or floating overlays.
unresolved: Consuming-project native component, icon, and design-token identities must be bound from accepted project evidence before implementation; this Orchestra reference contract does not invent project-native assets.
Exact custom accent color remains a consuming-project design input and must remain explicit until accepted design evidence supplies it.
